integrity: The mathematical proof and a self-contained finite checker are included; no independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The exact all-level formula is a 2^k-term explicit sum, not a simplified closed polynomial. Only ternary factor lengths and binomial order 2 are treated. The finite checker is not an infinite proof. Historical priority remains qualified.
title: Ternary-length \(2\)-binomial spectra of the binary Cantor word
